notes: συκῆν → fig tree heads on tree, the lexeme denoting a tree so that the English noun is a gloss rather than a generic completion, as rule 66 heads ζῷον → living creature on creature. The competing reading heads on fig, on the ground that the corpus spends bare tree on δένδρον — which this very verse does at δένδρα → trees — making tree the supplied completion as rule 104 reads ἑρπετῶν → creeping things.
παραβολήν is anarthrous, so the supplied a is an ordinary rule 7/51 helper on the noun; the ASV's reordering after the indirect object is permitted by rule 15.
